rules.statement: A Court should not interfere with a sale held under section 347 of the Code if no injustice has been shown by the party involved, as this view had stood unchallenged for over fifty years and it is important to maintain stable rules of procedure.
rules.supporting_quote: It is especially important for the proper and expeditious conduct of judicial business that the rules of procedure should be stable. Hence it is almost an invariable rule to adhere to former decisions settling the rules of procedure, when they are generally known and acted on, and when they have been established for such a length of time as to make a change injudicious, even though it may have become apparent that they were wrongly decided, or although the Court would have reached a different conclusion if the case were before it for the first time.
